name: OSS_MASS_UPDATE_CHARGE_ADJ
description: Mass Update Charge Adjustments table stores the charge adjustments for a products

columns.name: ID
columns.description: Primary Key

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: column represents set of records that need to be processed.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: APPLY_TO
columns.description: column represents type of charge to which adjustment need to be applied.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: stores sequence of adjustments.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_NAME
columns.description: column represents the name of adjustment.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_TYPE
columns.description: column represents the type of adjustment.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_VALUE
columns.description: column represents the value of adjustment.

columns.name: BASIS_ELEMENT
columns.description: column represents adjustment basis.

columns.name: EFFECTIVITY
columns.description: column represents term details.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_PERIODS
columns.description: column represents the number of periods for adjustment.

columns.name: PERIOD_FROM
columns.description: column represents period start.

columns.name: PERIOD_UNTIL
columns.description: column represents period end for adjustments

columns.name: REASON_CODE
columns.description: Charge Adjustment Reason Code based on ORA_OSS_BILL_ADJ_REASON lookup

columns.name: REASON
columns.description: column represents reason for adjustments.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_STEP_SEQ_NUM
columns.description: Category sequence number

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Charge adjustment category

columns.name: VALID_FROM
columns.description: The date from which the adjustment is effective

columns.name: VALID_UNTIL
columns.description: The date until which the adjustment is effective

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
